goal: Build a Python CLI tool that helps freelancers calculate net profit, estimate taxes, and track expenses by importing CSV files of income and expenses, applying configurable tax rates, and generating a clear financial summary report.
acceptance_criteria: User runs: python src/main.py --income data/sample_incomes.csv --expenses data/sample_expenses.csv --tax-rate 0.25 --output report.json
Tool reads both CSVs, calculates total income, total expenses, and gross profit.
Tool applies the tax rate to gross profit to calculate net profit and tax liability.
Tool outputs a structured JSON/CSV summary including totals, tax breakdown, and net profit.
Tool handles missing columns gracefully (skips or warns), handles empty files, and logs all operations.
